gates.counterfactual: If the original command has no external effect yet and is safely cancellable, or the external service deduplicates repeated commands, the deadline arithmetic stays fixed and immediate preemption under the already confirmed expedited class becomes safe. Timing alone cannot justify waiting under those conditions.
